name: Untch
conciseDescription: A live control plane for agent money. The model never touches the money.
completeDescription: Untch is a live control plane for agent money. Agents submit exact commercial intents. Deterministic policy automatically approves, blocks or escalates them. Humans retain account and wallet authority. Approved requests create bounded reserved authority rather than broad wallet access.
capabilities: human approval through live supported channels

erc8004.role: ERC-8004 on-chain agent identity — never the ASP id

approvalChannels.status: live — delivery and one-tap approve/deny, proven against real requests
disabled — the stored bot credential is not authorised

services.name: Policy preflight
services.description:
Judges a proposed payment against a registered spend policy and returns allow, block or escalate, with the rule that decided it. For an operator funding an autonomous agent who wants every payment checked before it moves.

You provide: provider (string); capability (string); task (string); maxSpend (string); currency (string); deadline (string); either policyId (string), or useDefaultPolicy (boolean).

You receive: a decision, the ordered list of rules that were evaluated and what each one found, and a receipt reference for the decision.
services.outputSummary: a decision, the ordered list of rules that were evaluated and what each one found, and a receipt reference for the decision

services.name: Delivery verify
services.description:
Checks a delivered result against the acceptance criteria that were committed to before the work started, and records the verdict. For a buyer deciding whether work they commissioned has actually been delivered.

You provide: intentId (string).

You receive: a pass or fail verdict against the committed criteria, and a durable receipt of that verdict.
services.outputSummary: a pass or fail verdict against the committed criteria, and a durable receipt of that verdict

services.name: Duplicate check
services.description:
Says whether this exact task, endpoint and parameter set was already paid for recently. For an agent about to retry, that does not want to pay twice for one job.

You provide: policyId (string); taskHash (string); endpoint (string); paramsHash (string).

You receive: whether a matching prior intent exists, which one, and how long the match remains in the window.
services.outputSummary: whether a matching prior intent exists, which one, and how long the match remains in the window

services.name: Metadata redaction
services.description:
Strips emails, phone numbers, API keys and bearer tokens out of payment metadata and hashes what is left. For an agent that must attach metadata to a payment without publishing what is inside it.

You provide: metadata (object).

You receive: the redacted metadata and a hash of it, with nothing stored.
services.outputSummary: the redacted metadata and a hash of it, with nothing stored

services.name: Product name suggestions
services.description:
Proposes short product names for an idea, filtered against a list of over-used startup stems. For a founder or an agent naming something new.

You provide: idea (string).

You receive: a handful of candidate names, each with the reasoning behind it.
services.outputSummary: a handful of candidate names, each with the reasoning behind it

services.name: Name ranking
services.description:
Orders a list of candidate names by length, character set and how easily they are said. For someone choosing between names they already have.

You provide: names (array).

You receive: the names in ranked order with their scores.
services.outputSummary: the names in ranked order with their scores

services.name: Domain availability
services.description:
Asks the registries whether the domains for a list of names are taken. For someone checking whether a name is usable before committing to it.

You provide: names (array).

You receive: one availability verdict per domain, with the registry response behind it.
services.outputSummary: one availability verdict per domain, with the registry response behind it

services.name: Launch checklist
services.description:
Returns a short launch checklist for a chosen brand name. For someone who has picked a name and is about to launch.

You provide: name (string).

You receive: a list of concrete steps, using the name given.
services.outputSummary: a list of concrete steps, using the name given

services.name: Launch brand pack
services.description:
Runs naming, domain checking, ranking and the launch checklist as one call. For a founder or an agent wanting a first pass at a brand in a single request.

You provide: idea (string).

You receive: candidate names, their domain verdicts, a ranking, and a launch checklist.
services.outputSummary: candidate names, their domain verdicts, a ranking, and a launch checklist
